method: Deterministic weighted-token Dice on short descriptive labels after removing generic occasion/household terms; minimum 2 significant shared tokens and score>=0.35; top three per source. Only a search worklist. NOT contextual semantic validation, NOT historical source verification, NOT an identity-merging algorithm.

known_false_positive_examples.reason: Christmas announcement bell and Easter bell ringing are different actions; token match alone misleads.
Christmas gift distribution and baptism gifts differ by occasion and ritual meaning.
Good Friday silence is not equivalent to hot-cross-bun practice.
